usedFor: WordPress holds site users, and WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta) greets new ones through “Send Template Message” after “New User Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Created” in Wordpress, then “Send Template Message” in WhatsApp Business Cloud
bestTemplate.why: A new site user gets a welcome template message through your WhatsApp Business Cloud account.

watchOut: “User Updates Profile” fires on each profile edit, so the same user could receive “Send Template Message” twice.
